name: prompt-optimizer
description: Drafts and improves the prompt you are about to send before the main session sees it: it keeps the submission out of the transcript, holds a short optimizer dialogue in its own state (a pane, or the prompt box itself on narrow terminals), and puts a finished draft back in the prompt box for your own Enter. One cheap completion per round, no fork, no transcript rewrite.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Intercept eligible prompts before they reach the main session.

modelGuidance.title: Model-specific guidance
modelGuidance.description: Use the main session model to select rewrite guidance. Off keeps common guidance only; the optimizer model is unchanged.

triggerMode.title: Trigger mode
triggerMode.description: "always" improves every eligible prompt; "prefix" improves only prompts that start with the trigger prefix; "smart" also lets a few exact approval replies (응, 계속, 진행해) reach the main session untouched.

triggerPrefix.title: Trigger prefix
triggerPrefix.description: Prefix that starts an optimization when trigger mode is "prefix"; "smart" recognizes it the same way before its own rules.

rawPrefix.title: Raw prefix
rawPrefix.description: Typed at the start of the prompt box, turns the optimizer off for that prompt (shown under the prompt; ctrl+u turns it back on). Empty disables it.

uiMode.title: Interface
uiMode.description: "auto" and "pane" open the dialogue in a pane and fall back to the prompt-box dialogue when it cannot be placed; "composer" always holds the dialogue in the prompt box.

refinementLevel.title: Refinement level
refinementLevel.description: quick edits wording and asks only critical questions; standard resolves consequential decisions; deep keeps the existing detailed interview.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model alias or id used for the optimizer's own completions.

maxTokens.title: Max tokens
maxTokens.description: Output cap for one optimizer completion (128-2048).

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Time limit for one optimizer completion (1000-30000).

maxRounds.title: Max rounds
maxRounds.description: Most completions allowed in one workflow (1-5).

contextTurns.title: Context turns
contextTurns.description: Recent user turns read into the context snapshot (0-8).

contextMaxChars.title: Context characters
contextMaxChars.description: Character budget for the context snapshot (0-8000).

systemPromptFile.title: System prompt file
systemPromptFile.description: Optional file with extra system instructions; empty keeps the built-in prompt.

pasteBypass.title: Send pastes as-is
pasteBypass.description: A prompt that was only pasted, or put in by another app such as Orca, and submitted without typing goes to the main session as-is. Typing anything in the draft makes it eligible again. Use /optimize status to inspect the last classification.
